scope: Triangulate current open-source peer reports of ACIS body loss at DWG AcDs input/output and DXF writer boundaries; refine the existing local plan gates without claiming a libdxfrw defect or promoting support.

method.kind: Primary GitHub issue/PR pages plus read-only local plan/source inspection
method.sourcePinning: Public issue/PR pages describe reports and proposals; no peer release, peer executable, or local runtime was pinned or executed in this research pass.
method.evidenceRule: Issue reports are test leads scoped to their named peer/version/route. Entity count, successful exit, section recognition, opaque bytes, and same-codec round-trip are separate from body association, independent geometry semantics, and native acceptance.

evidence.observed: Open issue #1411 describes an AC1032 REGION generated from a cube mesh with ezdxf, reporting a 5,489-byte SAB that disappears through a dxf2dwg/dwg2dxf path while the REGION record remains. The report also describes an unavailable R2018 customer file with 88 empty-body REGIONs. This pass did not reproduce either report or inspect the customer file.
doesNotEstablish: the normative DWG AcDs format or every producer's storage profile
valid ACIS topology from a nonempty payload
independent semantic proof from ezdxf self-generation/self-reading
evidence.planUse: At an optional composed transport gate, generate from scratch in temporary storage, hash the runtime SAB, and compare exact body presence/bytes across pinned tools. Treat the result only as carrier transport and do not commit the generated drawing.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp modeler entity omission at the DXF writer
evidence.observed: Open issue #1195 reports that ACadSharp 3.4.9 read typed 3DSOLID/REGION objects but omitted them during DXF writing, including solid-only block definitions. The maintainer confirms the referenced Dxf writer did not support Solid3D, CadBody and Region; the linked pull requests are proposed work, not released/runtime evidence. Customer drawings are not attached.
doesNotEstablish: that entity census alone proves geometry preservation
evidence.planUse: At the existing composed output inventory gate, test a model-space case and a solid-only block plus INSERT. Carry source handle, class, block path, inline/AcDs origin, emitted identity, payload disposition and warning/refusal separately.

evidence.observed: The current working tree contains implementation for DWG DataStorage parsing and an adapter-side ACIS/AcDs projection boundary. This source audit does not execute those routes or prove full linkage, writer compatibility, or downstream shape semantics.
doesNotEstablish: that every stored body is associated with the right modeler handle
that an emitted entity includes a nonempty valid modeler body
B-rep validity or native CAD rendering
evidence.planUse: Track body state separately from entity record state: inline-present, external-linked-and-resolved, not-required, expected-but-missing, ambiguous/unresolved, or malformed. The last three must fail closed or produce explicit non-success before output publication.

implementationReadiness.validationCadence: Per slice: touched strict build, one focused fast test, applicable LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 compatibility check, and diff check. Run pinned peer transport/writer and independent shape semantics only at their composed gates.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No downloaded or newly committed third-party DWG/DXF fixtures. Optional generated carrier files stay in disposable temporary storage; runtime-generated payload hash is captured rather than checked in.
nextActions: Continue local AcDs/ACIS work independently of peer issue status.
Add explicit body-state and per-owner source-to-output dispositions to the existing owned tests and receipts.
At a composed optional peer gate, generate the minimal AC1032 carrier and test a solid-only block plus INSERT without adding dependencies to per-slice builds.
Keep carrier fidelity, body association, B-rep semantics, and native consumer outcome independent.
